title: Martha Learns She Can’t Headbutt Children
description:
An Illinois woman accepted a plea deal after allegedly headbutting a 6-year-old child. Police took Martha Dunham, 36, into custody after she and a man she was staying with called 911 on each other, according to the Oregon Police Department. The calls came following an alleged argument between the pair that apparently led to Martha headbutting and pulling the hair of a child to “prove a point.” Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
